title: Define review-state retention and recovery evidence
description: Kubernetes review state is ephemeral. Missing restore evidence must remain not_verified.
acceptance_criteria: Document retention and export/import recovery scope; test recoverable synthetic review state and preserve missing-evidence semantics.
close_reason: Implemented b654995: bounded snapshot export/restore into an empty directory, checksum/schema/finding validation, no silent eviction, disk and memory rollback on write failure. 36 tests, strict types, lint, JSON and source hygiene passed. Synthetic CLI and real local HTTP checks preserve review decisions and not_verified; no production or cluster restore claimed.

title: Specify and test the imported evidence digest contract
description: Focused quorum 20261007T123322520415Z identified ambiguity in HTTP lab-import artifact_sha256: server hashes json.dumps(parsed report), not raw uploaded bytes or an explicitly canonical format. Coordinator reproduced different digests for equal synthetic objects with different key order, without executing a lab. Choose and document raw-artifact versus canonical-record semantics, label exports accordingly, and test HTTP/CLI consistency. Do not require key-order invariance if raw-byte identity is the chosen contract. Existing Content-Length body bounds are a separate control.
close_reason: Implemented c2d7ce3: separate exact raw-file/HTTP-request SHA-256 and versioned canonical-record digest; real HTTP/CLI equivalence, key-order/whitespace invariance, changed-record detection and nonfinite refusal tested. Legacy digests remain explicitly unspecified.

title: Specify optional shared sign-in boundary for CISO

acceptance_criteria: Define dedicated client, callback and role; permitted and denied viewer cases; no Headlamp session or Google token reused as an MCP credential.
close_reason: Obsolete: the prototype review UI was removed in phase 5 (retained at tag v0.1.1-prototype). CISO Assistant CE has its own login; no shared sign-in boundary is needed for the bridge.
